answer_1.quote: Text summaries provide short overviews of long documents or document collections... increasing research effort has explored machine models to generate summaries automatically.

answer_4.quote: To evaluate the quality of the summaries written during our study, we recruited a distinct set of annotators from Amazon Mechanical Turk... annotators evaluated each summary on four axes: coherence, accuracy, coverage, and overall.
